title: A copy's own words stay centred in their control
goal: When a copy of a component is given its own words, they sit off centre: a tab worded Privacy reads several points to the right of the middle of its tab, while the component's own word is centred. Anyone wording a row of tabs or buttons sees them look crooked.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-06 at Next defaults with Scripts/playtest/component-preview-walk.json (place_component words on a Tab whose Label is centred across a 96 wide box), measured on its picture with /tmp/pv/ink.py: 'Tab worded Privacy (own words): plate centre 430.0 pt, ink centre 441.0 pt, off by +11.0 pt', 'Tab worded Billing (own words): plate centre 540.0 pt, ink centre 547.0 pt, off by +7.0 pt', and for the look's own words 'Field worded Robin Avery: plate centre 379.5 pt, ink centre 380.0 pt, off by +0.5 pt'. Seen in the first draft of that walk too, before the wording change in applyOverrides, so that change did not cause it. Cause not looked into. See queue/audits/2026-11-06-component-preview-5-tab.png.
acceptance: A copy given longer words than its component's keeps them centred in the control, within 1 point, on the canvas and in Preview
A left or right aligned label stays left or right aligned when a copy rewords it
